text_markup: {card:Joshua B.}'s ability allows the Runner to gain [click]. If they do, it creates a delayed conditional ability that is independent of {card:Joshua B.} itself, which will meet its trigger condition only once, when that turn ends. After that ability resolves, the game no longer maintains the lingering effect creating the ability.
